Package com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent

Class ToolType

java.lang.Object
com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.ToolType
public final class ToolType extends Object
Immutable value object for a Select AI Agent tool type.

This type intentionally is not a closed Java enum. The constants cover tool types known by this SDK release, while of(String) also accepts tool types introduced by newer database releases. This keeps database metadata forward-compatible without requiring an SDK release for every new tool type.

Since:
1.1.0
